#!name=去广告
[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,ad.example.com,REJECT
DOMAIN,track.example.com,REJECT-TINYGIF
[URL Rewrite]
^https?://ad\.example\.com/x - reject
[Script]
fix = type=http-response, pattern=^https://api\.example\.com/feed, script-path=https://example.com/fix.js, requires-body=1
[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% api.example.com, *.ads.example.net

#!name=Loon 参数
[Argument]
lat = input,"31.2",tag=纬度,desc=十进制
on = switch,true,tag=开关
mode = select,"fast","slow",tag=模式
[Script]
http-response ^https://a\.example\.net/x script-path=https://example.com/x.js, tag=x, argument=[{lat},{mode}]
http-response ^https://a\.example\.net/y script-path=https://example.com/y.js, tag=y, enable={on}
cron "*/30 * * * *" script-path=https://example.com/c.js, tag=tick
[Mitm]
hostname = a.example.net
